content.text:
This is already a well-built, polished single-file component (good a11y, reduced-motion handling, localStorage sync, etc.), so "improve" is pretty open-ended. A few concrete things stand out that I could fix/add:

1. **Icon markup duplication** — the pause SVG path is hardcoded both in the HTML (`#pauseIcon`) and in JS (`PAUSE_ICON` constant), so they can drift out of sync.
2. **Keyboard-only speed control** — the circle button changes speed on click, but there's no keyboard shortcut (e.g. arrow keys) once it's focused; only Enter/Space work via default button behavior.
3. **No visible "reset to defaults"** — once a user changes speed/pause and it's saved to localStorage, there's no way to reset without clearing storage manually.
4. **Minor**: no `<meta name="format-detection">`/no favicon beyond a blank data URI (cosmetic only).

Do you want me to just clean up #1 (remove duplication) and add #3 (a reset option), or is there a specific direction you had in mind (visual design, performance, accessibility, code structure)?
